Fictional university public-opinion smoke scenario, inspired by the repository's university demo. This is not the original Wuhan University report or a claim about real events.
River University proposes extending library opening hours. Student representative Maya Chen supports later study access but asks for safe evening transport. Librarian Daniel Park supports a two-week trial and requests an extra evening staff member. Campus newspaper editor Asha Rao plans to interview students and publish the trial timetable. River University invites feedback from Maya Chen, Daniel Park and Asha Rao before deciding whether to continue the trial. The proposal has not yet been approved.
